A participant provided several high-level updates regarding international market penetration. Key points include: 
* Finland is expected to sign a 5-year contract within the next 14 days, with operations starting in January.
* The scope of the Finnish deal involves approximately 900 sensors covering 16,000 screens.
* A second real currency country is anticipated soon. 
* Australia did not proceed with the partnership this time; they opted for custom development instead of using the provided dashboard.
